answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: OSM: lift + stairs from the overpass to platform 1 and to island platform 2/3. Owner texts confirm the overpass and a step-free link from Asemaparkki to the platforms, but do not name lifts.

answers.answer: OSM has no station entrances. Asemaparkki A stair (Asemankaari) and B stair (Itäranta) per EuroPark.

answers.answer: Waiting area (VR/city/JOJO) and R-kioski (own site) settled.

open: Level heights: no source measures them; the laser pass flags platform 1 at only 0.58 m above the track bed vs class korkea (see REVIEW).
Lifts and overpass stairs are OSM only; no owner text names lifts. The overpass way itself is not among the OSM connections extracted (only its stairs/lifts).
Whether platform 1 is an edge platform at the Asemaparkki side and which face of the 2/3 island is platform 2: not confirmed by a plan.
Old station building: what remains open there (VR still says rail-replacement buses leave from beside the station building) is not described by any source read.
R-kioski, waiting area, WC and taxi are not in OSM: positions only as text ('ground floor of Asemaparkki').
Footbridge w58617254 (north-east): what it connects is not settled.
Väylävirasto station-area map could not be fetched; no plan read. Web search budget ran out during this pass.
